nodes.label: .`refresh sends operator_list_requested with the bare envelope and no session`()
.`an accepted list is parsed, sorted by display name, persisted and returned`()
.`blank and whitespace usernames are dropped and the rest are trimmed`()
.`a missing or blank displayName falls back to the username`()
.`an accepted empty list is valid and replaces the cache`()
.`a rejected response returns null and leaves the cache untouched`()
.`no response (timeout, not connected, malformed) returns null and keeps the cache`()
.`a request that throws is converted to null instead of propagating`()
.`a store that throws on save still returns null rather than crashing the login screen`()
